name: XOXO Comics

_upstream.attribution: Keiyoushi extensions-source contributors; modified as a Lua adapter for TachiKindle.

_limitations: Requires the bundled xoxocomics adapter for latest cards, union selectors, three-way lazy image fallback, deduplication and complete paginated chapter lists.
Upstream dynamic Genre/Status filters are not exposed by the current TachiKindle search API; query search is implemented.
Chapter pagination preserves DOM order, deduplicates repeated URLs, rejects cross-host links and cycles, and explicitly fails above 100 pages rather than returning a partial list.
Dates and status retain website display text; relative dates are not converted to upstream epoch timestamps.
Upstream accepts HTTP 404 image responses via an image-only interceptor. This adapter does not relax HTTP status handling; such images require a scoped transport enhancement and may fail.
No challenge bypass: live metadata probe returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare Just a moment; live parsing and reader image retrieval remain unverified.
